claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered_reaction (class_feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Countercharm fires on an external event (creature in range fails a save against charm/fear) and costs a Reaction. ClassFeatureMechanics has no triggered_reaction family — only activation. The spell surface has TriggeredReactionMechanics but that is spell-only. A parallel triggered_reaction family for class features is needed to represent this subgraph honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: reaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if the triggered_reaction family were added, the activation cost union needs a 'reaction' variant. Currently ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports 'free' and 'bonus_action'.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: reroll_save_with_advantage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is 'cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage'. This combines modify_roll_reroll and modify_roll_advantage (both v4 atoms) but neither appears in ClassFeatureEffect, which only has grant_extra_action and heal_hp.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Trigger condition: save_failure_against_condition_type (with range filter)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger is 'fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition' — a save-failure event filtered by the condition type the effect applies, scoped to creatures within 30 feet. No trigger grammar exists in the class-feature surface for this event shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition
